summary: The root cause is PDBot seeing a generic '[Golem]' token name in the MTGO game log and treating it as a non-PD-legal card, rather than recognizing it as a token generated by a legal card. The fix lives in PDBot's own codebase (not this repo). Someone with PDBot access should investigate its card-name validation logic to skip or whitelist generic token names.
